title: Test regular-expression languages
description: This program checks sample strings against five regular expressions with full-string matching.

steps.description: Each pair stores a pattern and strings to test. The patterns use repetition, grouping, alternation, and a digit class.
The outer loop selects one pattern. The inner loop visits every test string for that pattern.

steps.question: Will 'ababc' match the pattern 'ab*c'?
steps.answer: It does not match because the pattern permits b characters only between its initial a and final c.

steps.description: re.fullmatch checks whether the pattern consumes the entire string. The printed result labels each string as a match or no match.
The first call checks the current pattern against its current test string.
